description: This Java class defines a command object for deleting a feature's definition associated with a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, managing command payloads, and integrating with the command dispatching system.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinition
classes.description: Represents a command to delete a feature's definition on a specific 'Thing', providing JSON serialization/deserialization, payload management, and command categorization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DeleteFeatureDefinition command instance with explicit ThingId, featureId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeleteFeatureDefinition instance from JSON string or object.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity this command targets.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to the resource affected by this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds command-specific fields to the JSON payload with support for schema versioning.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, indicating delete operation.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization (returns false).

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on command's fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on internal fields.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equals, checks class compatibility.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the command instance.
